name: Audit Release Evidence
summary: Audit the release evidence chain for the current version and emit a machine-readable verdict report.
description: Invoked as a slash command, re-runs the repository release-readiness checks, verifies version consistency and changelog coverage, and emits a bounded release evidence report. It audits evidence; publication authority stays with the human release process.
risk_reason: This command audits the release evidence chain for the current version and emits a machine-readable verdict report; it does not publish, tag, bump versions, or bypass any release guard.
refuses: It does not publish, tag, bump versions, or bypass any release guard.
It does not treat a skipped check as a passed check; skips are reported as unknowns.
It does not start on a dirty worktree, because release evidence must attribute to the candidate.

entrypoints.purpose: Evaluate the declared preconditions deterministically before the workflow may begin.

produces: a machine-readable release evidence report naming every check, its output, and its verdict
requires: a clean git worktree so evidence attributes to the release candidate

flags.name: scope
flags.description: Restrict the audit to a declared subset of release checks.

operational.latency_reason: The command follows a precondition check and multiple workflow steps while it audits the release evidence chain for the current version and emits a machine-readable verdict report.
